name: kustomersuite-mcp
description: MCP server for Kustomer Suite: let an agent read a store's customer conversations, knowledge base, bot tool calls and usage.
author: Andi Kurniawan <https://github.com/andixurniawan>

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:edge: esbuild edge/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=es2022 --alias:os=node:os --alias:fs=node:fs --alias:net=node:net --alias:tls=node:tls --alias:crypto=node:crypto --alias:stream=node:stream --alias:perf_hooks=node:perf_hooks --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; import { Buffer as NodeBuffer } from 'node:buffer'; import { setImmediate as nodeSetImmediate, clearImmediate as nodeClearImmediate } from 'node:timers'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); globalThis.Buffer ??= NodeBuffer; globalThis.setImmediate ??= nodeSetImmediate; globalThis.clearImmediate ??= nodeClearImmediate;" --outfile=supabase/functions/kustomer-mcp/index.ts
